subject: Shift intro demo → engineering pairing + compact POC sprint — availability check
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amanda Cole <amanda@brightleafhealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Shift intro demo → engineering pairing + compact POC sprint — availability check

Amanda / BrightLeaf team —

Thanks again for taking the time to evaluate Redwood. After our prep call with your product team this morning and a quick alignment sync with our sales leadership, there’s appetite on both sides to move away from a pure high-level demo and instead run a hands-on engineering pairing session followed by a compact POC sprint. The motivation is twofold: BrightLeaf’s execs want to validate integration constraints quickly, and we can surface potential performance/cost tradeoffs earlier with a short pairing exercise.

Proposed plan (flexible):
- 90-minute engineering pairing: joint screen-share, walk through a mini-integration using a sanitized sample dataset, reproduce one of your core prompt flows.
- Compact POC sprint: 2–3 half-day remote sessions across a 1–2 week window where we run a short POC using your sample data and our private deployment template (VPC + sample keys).

Why this helps: faster technical validation, clearer success criteria for procurement, and fewer back-and-forths on infra assumptions.

Potential constraints we heard: your CPO mentioned travel the week of May 24–26. If that’s still the case we should avoid scheduling the pairing or critical POC days in that window.

Can you confirm:
1) Who will need to attend the 90-min pairing (engineer(s), architect, PO)?
2) Best days/times in mid-May for a 90-min slot (we’re PT-based but flexible for US timezones) — options below.
3) Will you be able to provide a sanitized sample of the dataset and a short list of the top 2 prompts/workflows we should validate?

Our availability (PT):
- Tue May 11: 10:00–12:00, 14:00–16:00
- Wed May 12: 09:00–12:00 (best for our eng leads)
- Thu May 13: 13:00–17:00

Attachments: proposed-poc-outline.pdf (3pp) — short agenda + goals; note: we’ll need a small infra check before the POC (see infra-checklist.md we’ll send from Dev).

Ask: please reply with attendees and 2 preferred time slots. If the exec travel window (May 24–26) is firm, tell us whether you prefer to move the POC to late May/early June or split sessions around travel.

Thanks — look forward to aligning.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Amanda Cole <amanda@brightleafhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 16:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Shift intro demo → engineering pairing + compact POC sprint — availability check

Rishi —

Thanks for outlining this — we like the approach. A couple notes from our side:
- The CPO (Carlos Nieves) is traveling May 24–26 and has asked not to schedule any critical sessions that week. That week is a hard block.
- For the 90-min pairing we’d want at least one backend engineer (Samir), our ML lead (Ava), and the PO (me) in the room. Samir has limited afternoons due to standups.

Good candidate slots (ET):
- Tue May 11: 13:00–14:30 ET (that maps to your 10–11:30 PT window)
- Wed May 12: 12:00–13:30 ET

Regarding the POC sprint: we prefer to compress to two focused half-days if possible — we can do either May 31 + Jun 1 or Jun 2 + Jun 4. If compressing will increase the chance we can get buy-in sooner, we’re open to it.

I’ll confirm attendees once I check Samir’s calendar. We will provide a sanitized subset of the dataset (PII removed) and a short list of top workflows by EOD Monday.

—
Amanda Cole
Head of AI Product | BrightLeaf Health
amanda@brightleafhealth.com

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shift intro demo → engineering pairing + compact POC sprint — availability check

Looping in a quick technical note from my side.

Rishi / team —

I’m available for the pairing on Wed May 12 (09:00–12:00 PT) and can take the lead on the hands-on sections. A few infra items we need to confirm before any POC starts:
- VPC peering or a temporary secure tunnel (we can use our ephemeral tunnel if VPC peering is not possible).
- Short-lived API keys (we’ll provide) and a sanitized sample dataset (CSV/JSON).
- Estimated runtime: for the compact POC I’m budgeting ~4 GPU-hours total (split across sessions). If BrightLeaf wants quantized inference or dedicated instances we should flag costs early.

Proposal: Instead of a 3-day block, compress the POC into two 4-hour half-day sessions. That reduces scheduling pressure and still surfaces integration issues. Suggested half-day windows (PT):
- Mon Jun 1: 09:00–13:00 PT
- Wed Jun 3: 09:00–13:00 PT

I’ve attached infra-checklist.md (short checklist) and will start a shared Drive with credentials instructions once Amanda confirms dataset delivery.

—
Dev Patel
Staff Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev@redwoodinference.com

Amanda / team —

Thanks — that all sounds good and realistic. To confirm next steps and what we’ll schedule: 
1) 90-minute engineering pairing: Wed May 12, 11:00–12:30 PT (this maps to your suggested mid-day slots). Please confirm final attendee list (Samir, Ava, Amanda).
2) Compact POC sprint: two half-day sessions — Mon Jun 1 and Wed Jun 3, 09:00–13:00 PT. Dev will lead the runs and we’ll provide short-lived keys and an infra checklist.

Action items for BrightLeaf:
- Share sanitized dataset + top 2 workflows by Mon May 9 EOD (Amanda).
- Confirm attendees for May 12 pairing (Amanda).

Action items for Redwood:
- Dev to create Drive folder and share infra-checklist.md and ephemeral key instructions (Dev).
- I’ll create the HubSpot activity and provisional calendar invites; please do not accept until attendees are confirmed. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/8472

If the CPO’s travel changes and you want to move POC dates, we can be flexible — wanted to get these provisional slots locked to unblock procurement.

Attachments: proposed-poc-outline.pdf (agenda) — we’ll update with attendee names once confirmed.

Thanks — looking forward to the pairing.

—
Rishi Malhotra

rishi@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123
